text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the path I envisioned was not 
mistaken after all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"'Rejoice. I am the light for none other 
than *all of you*.'"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up. ...I will never acknowledge 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days spent at summer training camp 
were intensely busy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sirius. How about the three of us have 
lunch together? Your Trainer invited me 
just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...You're pushing it with that joke. As a 
pickup line, that's a zero out of ten."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using every trick in the book, I tried to 
arrange contact between the two――

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Quite enthusiastic, aren't you, little 
puppy? Bringing in this many, are you sure 
you can read them all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After devouring training and psychology 
books—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the overseas racing scene? If I 
recall correctly, I still have data from 
my previous trip abroad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gathering the necessary materials for the 
overseas campaign—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You've managed to find quite the secluded 
training spot, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, what's on the menu? Since I won it, it 
better be worthy of the effort, right?
choice_data_list: I want to sprint up mountain roads!

I want to do a trail run around the whole 
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Well, this course isn't half bad.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to do a test run first. Record 
all the times starting after that."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...? What's up with that sullen look on 
your face?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every day, I searched for better training 
grounds to help hone her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, they did mention that there's a 
dedicated course for it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Give me the map. And then—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...? What's up with that sullen look on 
your face?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every day, I searched for better training 
grounds to help hone her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems fatigue had accumulated without 
me realizing as I continued through those 
days—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back from scouting the new 
training grounds... my legs just gave out 
completely, and I couldn't stand back up.
choice_data_list: (…Let's rest a bit before heading home.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sitting on the beach, I open my notebook 
outlining the plan. I only meant to 
quickly review the schedule... but in the 
blink of an eye, I drifted off to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A black haze is rising.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It gradually grew larger, eventually 
enveloping her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I'll bring you down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Don't let yourself be bound by Symboli 
Rudolf." "You need to run for your own 
sake."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You shouldn't let yourself be bound by 
Symboli Rudolf." "You have to run for your 
own sake."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many such words were thrown 
out—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll paint over it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if I throw—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I will trample everything that makes up 
that bastard, every last bit...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if I throw—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I don't give a damn about anything else!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't reach it. Before I knew it, I 
couldn't see a thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up—gazing at the sky as if 
searching for a star.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We must never let her forget. There is 
only one thing she should dream of—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the faint reply, I opened my 
throat wide and yelled with all my might.
choice_data_list:
Sirius is the star that deserves to shine 
the brightest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was the beach at night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only intended to rest for a little 
while, but it seems I completely fell 
asleep.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Go home already. ...Don't sleep in weird 
places.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The notebook thrust back into my hands 
was the very "Summer Sirius Plan" I hadn't 
let out of my sight all summer long.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...What's that? Someone collapsed—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer!? You—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ... ..........Just sleeping, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...Her face is still pale as a sheet. 
Should I make her spill the beans soon?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (What's this—"Summer Sirius Project"?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius's state of mind...? "Bearing 
witness to the change"...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Bottle up... the, emotions—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah! Are you an idiot...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(What complete delusion. Impossible. All 
that's left here is... for that weakened 
loser—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (With only... pure rage—...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...Then why do I keep hearing that guy's 
voice?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Why did her face flicker across my mind 
when considering my race rotation?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(No way, no way, no freakin' way! Argh, 
damn it, cool down, stay calm!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Like hell I'd harbor something like that 
inside me! There's no way something so 
childish, hideous, and trite exists in 
me!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah, haaah! ...Agh, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Why didn't you just say it straight in 
the first place?! We could've avoided all 
this roundabout nonsense...!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(What was the point of wasting so much 
time and energy, turning pale just to hide 
it?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Did you think I'd kick you to the curb if 
you spoke up? That I'd laugh at you for 
being insolent?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...No, or perhaps—)

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text: Hah!? *You* made this course, Teach!?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, when it comes to keeping it easy on 
your body, it was just faster to come up 
with it myself. Come on, give it a run, 
Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
...*yawn*... Huh...? Dad, you're not 
asleep yet...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, just looking into a few more 
things. You'd want our reconnaissance on 
the competition to be thorough, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(It was a messy notebook. Hypotheses 
scribbled all over the place, even 
dabbling into psychology. It was an 
unsightly mess with not a shred of 
composure in sight.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Are all Trainers like this? Desperately 
shielding them from even the slightest 
possibility of harm—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Acting like you're totally fine while 
ignoring your own struggles. Just like the 
old man and the doc—no, even more than 
them...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius should be the star that shines the 
brightest!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ………… ...It's abnormal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ............ ――"Operation Summer Sirius."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha, that name is so lame.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...Ain't like I feel lonely or anything. 
But—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I shouldn't just brush it off as 
"impossible," huh?)
